response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience with developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators), and clear leadership in open-source and knowledge-sharing, but lacks explicit evidence of people management experience and mobile-platform expertise, which are core to the role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven track record in open-source leadership and technical mentorship via workshops and projects
Broad technical stack spanning mobile, web, and infrastructure with real-world deployment experience
concerns: No clear documentation of formal people management or team leadership responsibilities
Limited evidence of mobile platform development beyond iOS app maintenance (not ecosystem-level)
No mention of strategic roadmap planning or organizational change leadership
